name: pg-facade
description: Typed PostgreSQL tools over MCP, read-only by default, with a skill for querying efficiently

dsn.title: PostgreSQL connection string
dsn.description: For example postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mydb. The assistant acts as this database user.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Expose only read tools and run every transaction read-only. Turn off to add the row write tools.
